theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy (Modified for User Preference)
theme_and_archetype.vibe: Calming, warm, human, tactile, safe. Avoid clinical or tech-heavy aesthetics.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-6, p-8), mobile-first bottom-nav orientation, optical alignment over strict geometric grids.

surfaces.cards: bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(45,40,42,0.04)] border border-[#EBE8E3]

buttons.primary: bg-[#8A7E94] text-[#FDFBF7] rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-lg hover:bg-[#74697E]
buttons.secondary: bg-[#F4F1ED] text-[#2D282A] rounded-full px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors hover:bg-[#EBE8E3]

components.navigation: Bottom-heavy or minimal sticky top header. Use Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFBF7]/80) only when content scrolls beneath.

Auth_Landing.layout: Full-height image background with soft bottom gradient overlay. Content anchored at the bottom.
elements: Google Login CTA (prominent, using secondary button style for soft contrast)
Auth_Landing.visuals: Use `calm_room_onboarding` image as absolute background object-cover. Gradient overlay: `bg-gradient-to-t from-[#FDFBF7] via-[#FDFBF7]/80 to-transparent`.

elements: Quote Card: Elegant italic Spectral font, slight accent color.
Mode Picker (Asymmetric Bento): 2 large touch targets.
Card A (Dominant): 'Center Your Mind' (manage and control your mind)
Card B (Softer/Supporting): 'A Listening Ear' (ask for therapy/help)
Recent Chats List: Left aligned, soft dividers. Max 5 items.

Chat_Screen.layout: Sticky header and sticky bottom input.
elements: Header: Mode badge ('Center Your Mind' or 'A Listening Ear') + Back link.
Crisis Banner: Conditionally rendered (crisis_detected). Warm terra-cotta background (#F5EBEB). Text: 'You are not alone. Please consider reaching out to a professional: [Helpline Numbers]'.
Messages: User bubbles (dusty lavender bg, white text). AI bubbles (soft sand bg, dark text).
Input: Sticky bottom wrapper with soft shadow. Lucide 'Send' icon (no emojis).

Subscription_Pricing.layout: Vertical stack of 3 cards, generous gaps.
elements: Highlight: Monthly card has subtle 1px border `border-[#8A7E94]` and a soft 'Recommended' badge.

Billing_States.Success: Calm, centered confirmation message. 'Your mind space is reserved.'
Billing_States.Cancel: Soft, guilt-free exit. 'Take your time. We are here when you are ready.'

motion.page_transitions: Fade in with slight upward drift (`translate-y-2` to `0`, opacity `0` to `1`).
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons shrink slightly on active (`active:scale-95`). List items stagger fade in.
motion.loading: Use opacity pulsing (`animate-pulse`) instead of jarring spinners.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts 'Spectral' and 'Figtree' in your index.css or via link tags.
Use lucide-react for all icons. NO EMOJIS.
Always apply data-testid to interactive elements (e.g., `data-testid='login-button'`, `data-testid='chat-input'`).
Follow mobile-first container width max-w-md mx-auto strictly to maintain the app feel.
Ensure contrast rules are respected (dark text on light sand backgrounds, white text on primary lavender).
Use Shadcn components but override their standard 'tech' look with the rounded-2xl, soft shadow classes defined above.
